description: One section of an ArenaAccordion: its header and the panel the header shows and hides. ArenaAccordionItem draws the heading, the button and the panel; the accordion it sits in decides whether the panel is open.

value.description: The item's identity, and what the accordion's `value`, `values` and their events carry. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: two blank values cannot be told apart, and the two items would open together.

label.description: What the header reads, and the accessible name of the panel. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a header with no words names nothing for the panel to borrow.

content.description: The panel's content. It mounts whether the panel is open or not, so put no costly work in it.
